page.title: Dried cherries, 8 oz at the shop

product.name: Dried cherries, 8 oz
product.description: A cool rest on Sunday evening is how the filling crew still finishes these, batch copper tray thirty.

blocks.text: You will find unsweetened dried cherries and not much else, packed Sunday evening as batch maple pail forty three.
The crew at the mill shed uses hand filling for this, and this one is batch cork rack fifty six.
The miller likes it for a jar of yogurt and wrote batch oak hook sixty nine on the slip.
Earlier $90.86, selling sixty seven dollars and fifty seven cents.

presentation.review_line: Look over the figures before you pay.
